association: Join RAW header using (epoch_id,stream_group_id=4,metadata_id), then verify capture_id, source_epoch, config_id, fir_id, sample_count and start_gsc. Allocator must not reuse metadata_id within a time epoch; exhaustion blocks new admission.
transport: Independent96-byte sidecar delivered by PS command23 PEEK25words and command24 exact metadata_id32/epoch_id32 POP. One slot reserved from AUX trigger until consumed and descriptor delivered; soft reset preserves metadata; cold reset requires host session cleanup.
raw_policy: Calibration IDs are candidate references, rx_cal_id remains zero. AUX is not automatically replayable. Template must be frozen at window admission; sample_count must describe actual retained bank length.
